description: This Java source file defines the AclEntryCreated event class, which is emitted when a new ACL entry is created for a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing, parsing from JSON, and accessing associated ACL entries, encapsulating event metadata and payload.

classes.name: AclEntryCreated
classes.description: Java class representing an event emitted after a Thing ACL entry is created in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends AbstractThingEvent and implements ThingModifiedEvent, providing methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessing event details.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for constructing AclEntryCreated instances with various combinations of parameters, including deprecated versions accepting String IDs.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static methods for creating an AclEntryCreated instance from JSON string or object, parsing event data.

methods.name: getAclEntry
methods.description: Accessor method returning the ACL entry associated with the event.
